newsitem.title: USA: Texas Pacific Group interested in Barney's - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Texas Pacific Group interested in Barney's - NYT.

text.p: Texas Pacific Group, an investment firm, has expressed an interest in Barney's Inc, the luxury clothier now in bankruptcy, the New York Times said.

In Thursday's edition, the Times quoted unnamed sources close to the creditors committee in bankruptcy proceedings as saying Texas Pacific has signed an agreement of confidentiality to review Barney's books.

Unlike other suitors who have emerged in the past year, including Saks Holdings Inc and Dickson Concepts (International) Inc, Texas Pacific is far removed from the retail arena. Its recent investments are in nursing homes, airlines, canned fruit and motorcycles.
This week, Barney's said it would close several underperforming stores, including its famed Manhattan location.
